svg.text: The time panel is a log scale, so a mark twice as far right is ten times the number, not twice it. Marks carry no bar because a bar on a log axis reads as a proportion it does not have.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The allocation panel is linear and starts at zero. † marks a warm mark that is not comparable with the others in its scenario, because that library reads and parses the file once at construction; its cold mark is the comparable one.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The dashed rule in each scenario stands at the baseline's warm value, so the distance from it to a mark is what that library's abstraction costs over the floor, ferry's read the same way.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generated by bench/cmd/perfreport from benchstat output; no figure on this chart was typed.
